verdict.rationale: Trello's own REST API reference lists a Webhooks resource alongside Batch and Search, which points to a first-party webhook capability. The evidence is only a navigation label, though, so it does not show how subscriptions or callbacks work. Missing for 10: documentation of registering a callback URL, the event or model types covered, payload format, delivery and retry and signature verification, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
